tex_content.html:
Definition
[$F$-structure]

Source: petersen:page-0334 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field An $F$-structure on $M$ consists of a finite covering of open sets $U_i$ of some finite covering space $\widetilde M\to M$, together with a Killing field $X_i$ on each $U_i$, such that whenever $U_i\cap U_j\ne \varnothing $ the fields commute there: $[X_i,X_j]=0$ on $U_i\cap U_j$. The $F$-structure is pure of positive rank when, roughly, the collection of local Killing fields is nowhere all simultaneously trivial in a suitable sense, measured via the function $f=\det [g(X_i,X_j)]$ (which reduces to $f=g(X,X)$ when only one field is given globally).
